description: Voice, video, and text communication service for building communities and gaming groups.
auth_notes: Bot tokens, OAuth2 bearer tokens, or HTTP Basic authentication using client ID and secret for token endpoints.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Discord account and create applications/bots on the Developer Portal at no cost.
api_notes: Covers channels, guilds, messages, users, webhooks, interactions, voice, audit logs, and real-time events via Gateway WebSockets.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Discord. Community-built MCP servers exist on GitHub.
rationale: Discord provides a comprehensive, publicly documented REST and WebSocket API with free self-serve developer credential creation.

evidence.note: Details authentication options including bot tokens, bearer tokens, and basic auth.
Developer Portal where applications and bot credentials can be created freely.
Comprehensive documentation covering Discord REST API resources and Gateway WebSockets.
